run_random_masking: run random_masking on a token tensor with a given mask probability to get a binary mask
run_frequency_based_masking: run frequency_based_masking on tokens with sampling weights and a mask probability to get a weighted mask
create_masking_strategy_enum: create a MaskingStrategy enum with RANDOM and FREQUENCY values for selecting a masking approach
test_random_masking: test random_masking to verify it returns a binary mask tensor with the correct number of masked tokens
test_frequency_based_masking: test frequency_based_masking to verify it masks tokens proportionally based on their sampling weights
